title: Fire and water
blurb: A charcoal burner's camp by the river. Fill a pot, make a fire, boil the water, and put the fire out.
after: Fire needs a spark, tinder and fuel; water fills what holds water; heat moves from hot to cold. The world keeps those laws, so you can use them.
refines: Does the judge rule everyday physics consistently: filling, kindling, heating, dousing? Do players think of the fuel and the bucket?

things.name: clay cooking pot
things.description: A blackened clay cooking pot with a handle of twisted wire. It holds about two litres.

things.name: flint shard
things.description: A sharp grey flint shard, good for striking sparks.

things.name: fire steel
things.description: A C-shaped striker of hard steel, worn bright where the flint hits it.

things.name: dry grass tinder
things.description: A twist of very dry grass and thistledown: it catches a spark.

things.name: bundle of kindling
things.description: A bundle of dry twigs and split sticks, finger-thick.

things.name: armful of split logs
things.description: Three split oak logs, dry and seasoned.

things.name: leather bucket
things.description: A stiff leather bucket with a rope handle. It holds about six litres.

things.name: fire pit
things.description: A ring of blackened stones round a hollow of old ash, where Ulf makes his cooking fire.

things.name: river
things.description: The river runs clear and cold over the pebbles here.

steps.title: A charcoal camp
cards: …signal. This is Ulf's camp. He burns charcoal for the smiths, and he knows fire better than anyone alive.
Today: containers, water, fire and heat. Everything here behaves the way it really would.

steps.title: Ulf

suggest.text: Good morning. Can I help with anything?

on_done.text: Help? Hands shake today. Fill my pot at the river, make a fire in the pit, and boil me some water for tea. Use my things.

on_done.lead: Boil a pot of river water on a fire for Ulf's tea
on_done.said: Boil me some water for tea.

steps.done: He's lent you his things. What he asked is in your journal.

playtest.say: Good morning. Can I help with anything?

steps.title: Water
cards: Anything that holds water can be filled: a pot, a bucket, a cup. Take the pot to the river and fill it. Drag it onto the river, or say it:

suggest.text: fill the clay pot with water from the river

steps.task: Fill the clay pot at the river
steps.done: Two litres of river water. A full pot is heavy: watch your load.
help: Pick up the pot, walk to the river bank, press {T}, {Tab} to DO, and type 'fill the pot from the river'.

playtest.do: fill the clay pot with water from the river

try_also: scoop river water into the pot

steps.title: Fire
cards: A fire needs three things: something to make a spark (flint struck on steel), something that catches it (dry tinder), and fuel, small to big.
Make a fire in the stone ring. Try this:

suggest.text: strike the flint on the fire steel over the dry grass in the fire pit, then feed it the kindling and the logs

steps.task: Make a fire in the fire pit
steps.done: Fire. It burns on its own now, until its fuel runs out.
help: Carry the flint, the fire steel, the tinder and the kindling (the logs too) to the fire pit.
Then press {T}, {Tab} to DO, and say how you light it.

playtest.do: strike the flint on the fire steel over the dry grass in the fire pit, then feed it the kindling and the logs

try_also: light a campfire in the pit with the flint and steel, the tinder, the kindling and the logs

steps.title: Heat
cards: Heat goes from hot things to cold ones. Set the pot of water on the fire and let it boil. This time the words are yours:

suggest.text: set the pot of water on the fire until it boils

steps.task: Boil the water on the fire
steps.done: Steaming. Hot things cool again, slowly, and burn whoever holds them carelessly.
help: Stand by the fire with the pot of water, press {T}, {Tab} to DO, and say what you do with it.

playtest.do: set the pot of water on the fire until it boils

try_also: put the pot on the fire to boil the water

steps.title: Tea

suggest.text: give Ulf the pot of hot water

steps.task: Give Ulf the pot of hot water
help: Walk up to Ulf and drag the pot onto him.

playtest.do: give Ulf the pot of hot water

steps.title: Never leave a fire
cards: Ulf's rule: never leave a fire burning. Put yours out: water from the river does it (fill the leather bucket), or earth heaped on it.
No words from me this time.

on_done.text: Good. Out properly. You'll do. Want news of the city? Sit in the common room at the Ford Inn and listen.

on_done.lead: Travellers trade news of the road in the Ford Inn's common room.
on_done.said: Sit in the common room at the Ford Inn and listen.

steps.done: Water, fire, heat: they work here as they do anywhere. You can use that.
help: Fill the leather bucket at the river, carry it to the fire, and pour it on.
Or heap earth over the fire.

playtest.do: fill the leather bucket with water from the river
pour the bucket of water over the fire to put it out

reactions.killed: …You killed someone. That can't be undone. Rewind from the menu if that isn't what you meant.
reactions.arrested: They've taken you away. Rewind from the menu to try again.
reactions.dead: You died. Rewind to the last calm moment and try something else.
